title: Data Center Operations Manager and Metro Leader at Microsoft Sees 800 VDC Pressuring Vertiv’s UPS Business but Creating Sidecar Opportunities
expert: Data center procurement program manager at Microsoft (current, 3 years; global remit over power and cooling; 12 years incl. AWS long-lead procurement); interview 2026-11-09
verdict: A Microsoft data-center procurement manager with a global power-and-cooling remit sees Vertiv air-cooled chillers failing at a low-double-digit annualized rate vs low single digits at Trane and York, and native 800 VDC removing the UPS by 2030 or the early 2030s.

Share in the converged and 800V transiti: 🔴 Vertiv air-cooled chillers fail at low double digits annualized vs low single digits at Trane and York, losing share; consistent with SemiAnalysis quality checks (SB #64027). → Tenet 5 (share) ↓ {c1}
🔴 Native 800 VDC could eliminate the conventional UPS by 2030 or early 2030s, consistent with SemiAnalysis LV UPS displacement (SB #65942). → Tenet 5 (share) ↓ {c11}

🟡 800 VDC sidecars widespread by late 2027 or early 2028, lasting at least four years; Delta and LITEON lead unless Vertiv builds one, vs Vertiv 800VDC vetted by YE26 (SB #64670): conflicting. → Tenet 2 (content per MW) → {c19}
Orders / backlog conversion: 🟢 AI build growth 16-30% y/y over the past couple of years (estimate) with racks heading to 300 kW and 400 kW; open whether it holds into the 2030s. → Tenet 1 (order-led growth) ↑ {c25}
Services (Tenet 4): 🟢 King Environmental and PurgeRite add wetted-loop performance testing for 100 kW cluster pain points; first read. → Tenet 4 (services) ↑ {c10}

changes: Chiller failure rate low double digits vs SemiAnalysis checks still pointing to Vertiv product-quality issues (SB #64027): consistent.
Vertiv CDUs lag CoolIT and Schneider vs a former Vertiv manager's ≥60% CDU share on NVL72 (SB #64606): conflicting.
Sidecar timing late 2027/early 2028 with Vertiv progress unclear vs Google architect: Vertiv 800VDC solution fully vetted by YE26 (SB #64670): conflicting.
UPS displacement by native 800 VDC vs SemiAnalysis LV UPS (~20–25% of revenue) displaced by MV UPS (SB #65942): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 5 (share and execution): ↓ — chiller failure rates low double digits vs low single digits at Trane/York; UPS at risk from native 800 VDC.
Tenet 2 (content per MW): → — sidecar upside described as "exponential" if Vertiv builds one, against UPS content loss.
Tenet 4 (services compounding): ↑ — King/PurgeRite wetted-loop testing addresses 100 kW cluster pain points.
Tenet 1 (order-led growth): ↑ — AI build growth 16-30% y/y; racks to 300 kW and 400 kW.
